instrument_fastapi_telemetry: instrument a FastAPI app with OpenTelemetry tracing using the Instrumentor class
instrument_redis_requests: instrument Redis operations with OpenTelemetry spans using the redis_request_hook callback
instrument_sqlalchemy_queries: instrument SQLAlchemy database engine queries with OpenTelemetry tracing
instrument_httpx_client: instrument HTTPX async and sync HTTP client requests with OpenTelemetry request and response hooks
instrument_aiohttp_client: instrument aiohttp HTTP client traces with OpenTelemetry spans for request start, end, and exception events
